sql: SELECT y.trip_date, y.avg_total_amount AS target_avg_total_amount, y.avg_trip_distance AS target_avg_trip_distance, AVG(CASE WHEN d.d_dow = 6 AND d.d_date <> DATE '2024-12-21' THEN y.avg_total_amount END) AS baseline_avg_total_amount, AVG(CASE WHEN d.d_dow = 6 AND d.d_date <> DATE '2024-12-21' THEN y.avg_trip_distance END) AS baseline_avg_trip_distance FROM whybot.yellow_daily y JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date WHERE d.d_dow = 6 AND y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31' GROUP BY y.trip_date, y.avg_total_amount, y.avg_trip_distance ORDER BY y.trip_date LIMIT 500
